summary: Testing OI button toggle bug fix on ChartPanel. Found and fixed 1 critical z-index bug: OI button toggle (Turn OFF) was broken because backdrop (z-40 fixed inset-0) was covering the OI button (z-index: auto), intercepting the click. Fixed by adding 'relative z-50' to OI button className. All 9 backend tests + all 6 frontend OI tests now pass.

rca_of_the_issue.bug: OI button second click (Toggle OFF) did not work — panel closed but price lines stayed on chart, button stayed purple
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The OI panel's backdrop element ('fixed inset-0 z-40') covered the OI button (position:static, z-index:auto). When clicking OI button while panel was open, the backdrop intercepted the click (confirmed via document.elementFromPoint), firing only setOiPanelOpen(false) instead of the full toggle handler that also calls setOiLinesOn(false). This required 3 clicks to fully turn off instead of 2.
rca_of_the_issue.confirmation: document.elementFromPoint(btn_center_x, btn_center_y) returned the backdrop DIV instead of the OI button. JS btn.click() bypassed z-index and worked correctly.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added 'relative z-50' to OI button className in ChartPanel.jsx line 3443. btn_zIndex now=50 (above backdrop z-40). element at btn center now correctly returns the OI button.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction_steps: 1. Load NIFTY chart 2. Click OI button (turns ON — panel + lines) 3. Click OI button again — panel closes BUT lines remain and button stays purple (BUG) 4. After fix: second click correctly closes panel AND removes lines AND reverts button to grey
